annotation.title_clean: Workplace Safety and Health Regulation, M.R. 217/2006 (under The Workplace Safety and Health Act, C.C.S.M. c. W210)
annotation.title_en: Workplace Safety and Health Regulation, Manitoba Regulation 217/2006
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Manitoba (Legislative Counsel / Minister responsible for Workplace Safety and Health)
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual consolidated Manitoba Workplace Safety and Health Regulation (M.R. 217/2006), a comprehensive occupational safety code covering 44 parts. Part 16 specifically regulates robots and robot systems (industrial manipulators), alongside machine safeguarding, lockout, mobile equipment and other workplace hazards. Current to October 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Part 16 (ss. 16.29-16.33) sets safety requirements for robots and robot systems, with definitions of robot, robot system and restricted work envelope.
Employers must develop safe work procedures, train workers and eliminate or control risks.
Machine safeguarding, emergency stop and lockout requirements apply to machines and tools.
Certain safety measures must be certified by a professional engineer and conform to referenced CSA/ANSI/ISO standards.
Regulation came into force 1 February 2007 and has been amended repeatedly, most recently by M.R. 19/2026.
